thread:
Alex: FYI we just got a partner support ticket from AcmeEdge — they say ~12% of their hourly usage batches are disappearing when they have delayed delivery >36h. Linking ticket: https://acme.support/INC-4521
Maya: ugh. is this our ingest TTL or partner side dropping?
Alex: initial traces show we receive duplicate ack for some batches, others never arrive. looks like their gateway retries then collapses into a single batch and sometimes payloads trimmed. sample payload posted in ticket.
Jordan: can you drop the sample here? easier to triage than the ticket link.
Alex: pasted sample json from partner (redacted):
```
{"customer_id":"acme-123","window_start":"2026-02-18T14:00:00Z","records":[],"signature":"..."}
```
Maya: empty records array — that explains zero usage for that window. do they send an empty body when they compact?
Samir: Acme told us they compact older events when backlog >72h. they roll into a summary which sometimes omits small-volume customers. bad for our per-customer entitlements.
Jordan: two quick asks: 1) detect and flag empty-window payloads as potentially stale (so we don't treat as zero usage without manual review). 2) backfill path: accept replayed raw events for 7 days and treat as source-of-truth if signature verifies.
Maya: agree. suggestion: set an ingress gate that rejects empty-record payloads with 202 + info header pointing to replay endpoint, but doesn't mark them as 'no-usage'. this would avoid accidental zeroing.
Samir: technical note — current webhook handler writes a zero if records.length==0. change would be small: write a tombstone status 'pending-replay' and emit alert to partnerships queue. fallback for existing customers: run a one-off job to mark windows as "pending-replay" for the last 30 days where we got empty arrays from partner.
Alex: can billing-bot give us a quick list of affected customerIDs for Acme in the last 60 days?
billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner = 'acmeedge' AND received_at >= '2026-01-23' AND (records_count = 0 OR payload_summary = 'empty_compaction'); estimated rows: ~430
Maya: cool. next steps: Samir to prototype ingress gate + status field, Jordan to coordinate replay endpoint contract with Acme, Alex to draft partner comms and support triage guide. I'll own the backfill job once Samir flags windows.
Samir: I'll put a short design in the partnerships runbook and push a PR for the webhook handler tomorrow. linking runbook draft: https://internal/runbooks/marketplace/empty-window-replay.md
Jordan: Acme wants a SLA on replay acceptance window. propose 7 days standard, 30 days for enterprise partners with reserved capacity. thoughts?
Maya: 7d default sounds right. for 30d we'll require signed manifests and CSVs for high-volume customers.
Alex: I'll draft the partner-facing FAQ and include example payloads + the new error header. pinging @Maya and @Jordan for review before I send. :thumbsup:
Samir: temporary mitigation: I'll add an alert rule for spikes in empty-window rate per partner (>1% of hourly windows) so ops can catch regressions quickly.
billing-bot: Action items recorded: ["Samir: webhook handler PR", "Jordan: replay endpoint contract", "Alex: partner comms + triage guide", "Maya: backfill job owner"].
Alex: thanks all — let's sync in the partnership standup on Monday.
